policy.re_execution: FORBIDDEN - publication/communication over accepted D9-D evidence only; no retrain, retune, reacquire, rerun 2025, or artifact rewrite
policy.numbers_source: accepted artifacts under results/ plus the append-only ledger; no number in this pack may originate outside them
policy.superseded_material: the v1 study is preserved unmodified, is non-conforming to the final D9-D standard, and none of its numbers are reused as evidence here

accepted_evidence.accepted_head_subject: D9-D: 2025 HISTORICAL EVALUATION -- executed once, credible null
accepted_evidence.label_reason: AAPL/MSFT/AMZN 2025 outcomes were already inspected under the preserved v1 study; the remaining nine issuers were never isolated into a substitute confirmatory sample
accepted_evidence.external_git_shas_note: Hashes of objects in OTHER repositories (the stale sentiment PR #4 and the central hub tip). They cannot be resolved from this clone and are verified as declared values only; they appear in this pack solely to evidence that neither was modified by D10.

superseded_predecessors.sentiment_hist_text_v1: EXPLORATORY / NON-CONFORMING TO FINAL D9-D (3 issuers, 8-K only, non-LM embedded lexicon, day-level sample unit with manufactured non-event days, raw rather than excess-return targets, no real NYSE calendar). Preserved unmodified for audit trail; none of its numbers are reused.

dataset.raw_data_note: Raw filings text and price CSVs are NOT committed to this repository (data/ holds manifests only). The canonical dataset hashes are manifest-declared values that the run-time frozen-input gate re-verified from local bytes at run time; they cannot be re-derived from the repository tree and are treated as accepted, disclosure-limited inputs.
dataset.universe_bias_disclosure: Static, present-day-selected universe of 12 large currently-listed issuers plus SPY; carries survivorship/selection bias (no delisted, merged, or historically-prominent-but-now-obscure issuers). Disclosed, not hidden.

canonical_dataset_hashes.note: manifest-declared canonical dataset hash. Raw filings text is not committed, so this value cannot be re-hashed from the tree; it is verified by requiring the exact string to be physically present in the hash-verified manifest AND in both hash-verified 2025 artifacts (two independent sources agreeing).
manifest-declared canonical dataset hash, same verification rule as the filings canonical.
training-row index fingerprint recorded by the accepted primary 2025 run. Target-specific, so it is anchored only where it is recorded.

source_artifacts.role: PRIMARY 2025 historical evaluation (the D10-D headline subject)
pre-2025 development internal OOS test block (primary)
pre-2025 development internal OOS test block (secondary)
pre-2025-only final C selection grid (source of the frozen C values)
frozen filings manifest (declares per-file hashes + canonical dataset hash)
frozen prices manifest (declares the 13 per-file CSV hashes + canonical dataset hash)
append-only experiment ledger (v2 rows carry artifact hashes + key_metrics)
holdout audit, classification rules and pre-committed 2025 label
authoritative v2 study implementation at the accepted HEAD
SUPERSEDED v1 2025 run (non-conforming; preserved; not a publication source)
SUPERSEDED v1 2024 run (non-conforming; preserved; not a publication source)
SUPERSEDED v1 development run (non-conforming; preserved; not a publication source)

checks: every source_artifacts sha256 re-measured against disk bytes
tables/ and figures/ rebuilt deterministically and byte-compared (CI additionally requires a clean git diff after build)
every (path, sha256) citation in RESULT-SOURCE-MAP.md re-verified
every 64-hex token anywhere in the pack is a declared or measured hash
every 40-hex token is a declared git object, resolved with git cat-file
the headline numbers are independently re-derived from the accepted artifacts by a script sharing no code with the generator

generated.tables/artifact-hashes.csv: measured sha256 + byte size for every declared source artifact, next to its declared value
generated.tables/period-metrics.csv: per period x target x model metrics exactly as recorded in the accepted artifacts
generated.tables/target-comparison.csv: per period x target headline comparison (model3 minus model1), bootstrap CI, geometry and provenance fields
generated.figures/log-loss-comparison.svg: deterministic grouped bars: 2025 log loss per model, per target, with M3 highlighted against its M1 headline comparison
